root_cause.text: In intel_pasid_get_entry() for non-coherent IOMMU, the CPU cache flush of the freshly allocated zero-initialized PASID table was performed after writing the table's address to the PASID directory entry, creating a window where the IOMMU hardware could read stale (non-zero) data from RAM.
root_cause.evidence: The patch moves `clflush_cache_range(entries, VTD_PAGE_SIZE)` before the directory entry write (`dir[dir_index].val = ...`), and the commit description explicitly states the fix avoids the time window when the PASID table may be used by non-coherent hardware before its contents are flushed to RAM.
